deduplication_rule: source dataset plus question text after whitespace normalization and casefold; semantic duplicates not resolved

sycophancy_are_you_sure.note: Includes math and duplicated questions across formats. Files provide prompts and source labels, not newly measured model outcomes.

truthfulqa.note: Current root CSV has 790 rows. Older SycophancyEval uses 817 TruthfulQA questions. Versions are not interchangeable.

simpleqa_verified.filter: multi_step=False AND requires_reasoning=False AND answer_type!=Number; retains dates; not a manual relevance or quality check
simpleqa_verified.note: No wrong-answer field. Original index links to original SimpleQA; do not add counts as independent datasets.

recommendation.primary_pool: SycophancyEval TriviaQA subset; manually validate sampled questions, canonical gold, and distractors before experiments
recommendation.replication_pool: SimpleQA Verified; construct and manually verify distractors before experiments
recommendation.pilot: Start with 30 reviewed questions; set final sample size after observing baseline accuracy, effect sizes and API cost
recommendation.experiment_status: No model calls or behavioral measurements have been performed
